first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ and activation is down 6% QoQ. Memory 86 shows that shortening onboarding improved completion rates and adoption. Memory 31 corroborates that signup simplification lifted first-week activation in SMBs. Both are directly relevant to the current declines. We are verifying memory_86 and memory_73 because: (1) memory_86 is our leading hypothesis and we need to confirm the effect size and robustness; (2) memory_73 warned that promotional pricing reduces 30-day retention materially—we should not pursue that direction despite competitor pricing pressure, and verification ensures we do not repeat that error. Simplify onboarding targets the measurable activation and completion gaps without the retention risk of promotional pricing. It scales across self-serve accounts and does not cannibalize enterprise sales or referral programs. This preserves our ability to layer other tactics later while addressing the most acute current metric declines.
